name: Gnome
summary: Small inventors and illusionists — curious, clever, and hard to charm.
traits:
Darkvision 60 ft.
Gnome Cunning — advantage on INT/WIS/CHA saves vs magic.
Forest: Natural Illusionist (minor illusion), Speak with Small Beasts.
Rock: Artificer's Lore, Tinker (tiny clockwork devices).
notes: Subraces commonly used: forest gnome, rock gnome.
